$comment: Assignment 6, Part B: the investigator's return (checks/FORMATS.md, section 14.4). The coordinator validates every return against this schema with harness.schema.errors before it acts on it, and records it as a worker_return line. result, status, not_searched and could_not_determine come from the model's return tool; searched and calls_used are written by code, from the worker's own tool calls, never by the model. The anyOf says that a found or candidate return names a label and a file; only out_of_budget may leave them null.
title: worker_return
